game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Royal Granary, the king's grain stores: the knight must hold off goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Reassign Relay: Overwrite a variable with a fresh value each round so the old number vanishes before goblin raiders can use it.
theme: The Kingdom – Royal Granary: the king's grain stores
core_gameplay_loop: In Royal Granary, repeat each round: Overwrite a variable with a fresh value each round so the old number vanishes before goblin raiders can use it. Then check wave_target and advance.
player_objective: Protect the drawbridge from goblin raiders in Royal Granary: keep wave_target above zero until the 26-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 2 (intro tier): Reassign Relay
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 1, Level 2, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
